scripts.build:hosted: npm run prepare:assets && vite build --mode hosted
scripts.build:local: npm run prepare:assets && vite build --mode local-app && node src/local/stage.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build:hosted && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name fecim --branch development --commit-dirty=true
scripts.test:e2e:build: npm run build:hosted && npm run build:local && npm run test:e2e
